meta.about: Drakes in combat (docs/drakes.md). Wiki (Drake): attack styles Ranged and 'Ranged melee', both max hit 15; the shot is blocked by Protect from Missiles (the swing is typed ranged as its listed style, ours); attack speed 4; they melee from a diagonal too. The rest is from the rsprox capture of recording 3014 (rev 231, ticks 217-229): the animations, the projectile (start 44, end 57 + 3 a tile from the drake's head, heights 80/90 and angle 10, progress 128 as sent), the sounds and the hit delays (ranged 2 ticks at 2, 6 and 7 tiles; melee the same tick).
meta.ids: drake 8612 (8613 is its death form). The Guardian Drake superior (10400) has its own attacks and is not one of these.
